text: dsh-chat-wallpaper 是面向 DSH Web 的聊天背景插件。它通过宿主 HTTP 路由提供本地视频与图片，并由浏览器客户端接入开场动画、聊天底图和设置面板。功能包括开机动画后的全屏视频播放、视频循环与时间码区间、自动选择图片背景、浅深色主题纱层、大字横幅，以及设置页选图和重播。适合希望个性化 DSH 聊天界面与开场体验的用户。配置可选，媒体使用本地文件；仓库已标记停止维护，README 建议改用 dsh-boot-suite。

dsh-chat-wallpaper adds backgrounds to DSH Web. It serves local media and provides an intro video, wallpaper, text banner, theme controls, and settings panel. Users can loop video segments, choose images, and replay the intro. The repository is deprecated; its README recommends dsh-boot-suite.

怎样在设置页预览和切换背景图片？
想让背景视频按指定片段循环播放。
I want to use my own image as the DSH chat background.

I want a subtle text banner behind the chat messages.
How can I pick a wallpaper and replay the intro from settings?
dsh-chat-wallpaper 的功能「开场视频」：开场视频：在启动动画收场时播放全屏视频，播放一次后淡出；设置可从面板触发重播。
dsh-chat-wallpaper 的功能「聊天底图」：聊天底图：选择本地图片作为聊天窗口背景，或从默认图片目录自动采用最新图片。
dsh-chat-wallpaper 的功能「大字横幅」：大字横幅：在聊天内容后显示可配置的一行矢量文字，并可调节透明度。
dsh-chat-wallpaper 的功能「背景设置面板」：背景设置面板：列出图片、切换选中图、打开图片目录、调整纱层和横幅，并选择开场或循环模式。
dsh-chat-wallpaper 的功能「视频循环」：视频循环：配置循环起止点，可使用秒数或 HH:MM:SS:FF 时间码指定片段。

**三层互不依赖**：

| 你配了什么 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 只配视频 | 开机 → 全屏开场演一遍 → 淡出 → 回到 DSH 默认底色 |

| 视频 + 底图 + 大字 | **开场在前演，演完淡出 → 露出"聊天 + 你的底图 + 那行大字"** |

dsh-chat-wallpaper README · 它怎么做到"背景而不覆盖"：只有两处"魔法"：

```css
/* 1) 把外壳底色变量改透明。面板/卡片/代码块用的是**别的**变量，一律不动，
      所以文字永远落在实心底上，可读性一点不损失。 */
html body {
  --dsw-alias-bg-base: transparent;

上面再压一层**纱**（`linear-gradient`）：浅色主题压白纱、深色主题压深纱。

> 主题判定**不猜 DSH 内部的标记名**：JS 先扫 `html`/`body` 上所有属性找 `dark`，
> 再兜底量一次外壳底色亮度，然后把结果写成**自己的 class**（`dsh-cw-dark` / `dsh-cw-light`），
> CSS 只读这个 class。这样 DSH 内部标记怎么改名都不影响。

dsh-chat-wallpaper README · 交叉叠化：这个插件里最难的一段：**问题**：开机动画的结尾是淡出，开场视频的开头如果也淡入，**两段淡的交界处两层都不够实**，
中间就会闪出聊天窗口。

**做法**：**让别人的淡出变成我的叠化** —— 在他开始淡的那一瞬间，我已经满不透明地待在他下面。

这需要精确知道他什么时候开始淡。我们读了 `dsh-startup-screen` 的源码，它的收尾是**两步**：

```js
/* dsh-startup-screen/lib/splash.js —— 揭幕 */
root.classList.add('dsu-handoff')   // ★ 第 1 步：根元素【开始】淡出
await wait(780)                      //   整整 780ms
finish()                             // 第 2 步：这才加 dsu-gone（再淡 620ms）
section: 交叉叠化：这个插件里最难的一段

text:
dsh-chat-wallpaper README · 交叉叠化：这个插件里最难的一段：```css
/* dsh-startup-screen/lib/splash.css:791 */
#dsh-startup-root.dsu-handoff {
  transform: scale(1.035);
  filter: blur(5px);

**所以：**

```
t=0      dsu-handoff  → 开始淡出（780ms，带推进 + 失焦的运镜）↘
                                                                ← 我已经满不透明地等在下面
t=780    dsu-gone     → （此时早就透明了）
t=1400   根元素被移除

> ⚠️ **只盯 `dsu-gone` 会晚 780ms** —— 那 780ms 里开机动画一路在变透明、
> 已经在把聊天窗口透出来了，用户看到的就是"闪一下"。**这是我们踩过的坑。**

信号 class 是可配置的（`bootLeaveClasses`），换别的开机动画插件时改这一行即可。

text:
dsh-chat-wallpaper README · 交叉叠化：这个插件里最难的一段：**代价（诚实说明）**：叠化意味着视频在淡出过程中就已经开播，
所以片头最前面约 0.4～0.7 秒会有部分被正在淡出的开机动画盖着。
这是"绝不闪屏"的取舍 —— 我们认为值得。

第二处衔接（视频 → 你的底图）同理：视频层淡出的**同时**底图在下面逐渐露出，
本身就是叠化，不用额外处理。

dsh-chat-wallpaper README · 换视频 / 换底图：**换视频** —— 丢进这个文件夹就会自动用（按修改时间，最新的赢）：

```
~/.dsh/boot-animation/videos/
```

> ⚠️ **桌面版（Electron）用户请用 VP9/WebM**。桌面版 Electron 不带 H.264 解码器，
> 片库的 mp4 一放就是 `PIPELINE_ERROR_DECODE`（code 3）。插件现在的处理是：
> 只撤视频层、保住底图/横幅，并在日志里给出提示。转一遍即可：
>
> ```
> ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -b:v 0 -crf 30 -an out.webm
> ```
>
> Web 端（浏览器）没有这个限制，mp4 / webm 都能放。

**换底图** —— 丢进这个文件夹就会自动用：

```
~/.dsh/chat-wallpaper/
```

支持 `jpg / jpeg / png / webp / gif / avif / bmp`。
**不丢图** → 开场播完淡出后，回到 DSH 默认底色。

dsh-chat-wallpaper README · 诊断与工具：| 端点 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `GET /chat-wallpaper/status` | 现在解析到哪个视频/哪张图、来源、丢图目录、循环时间码换算成多少秒 |
| `GET /chat-wallpaper/config` | 客户端实际收到的配置 |
| `GET /chat-wallpaper/images` | 设置面板用：图清单 + 当前选中 |
| `GET /chat-wallpaper/video` | 视频流（带 Range 支持 —— `<video>` 需要它） |
| `GET /chat-wallpaper/image` | 底图（`?name=xxx` 可指定丢图目录里的某一张） |

浏览器控制台里所有日志都带 `[chat-wallpaper]` 前缀，第一行是 **`client build cw-N 已加载`**
—— 出问题时先看这个号，一眼分清"代码有问题"还是"浏览器跑的是旧包"。

**两个开箱可用的检查工具**（不需要装 ffmpeg）：

```bash
dsh-chat-wallpaper README · 看视频规格：真实分辨率 / 帧率 / 时长 / 是否 faststart / 编码 / 关键帧位置：node test/inspect-mp4.mjs "你的视频.mp4"
section: 看视频规格：真实分辨率 / 帧率 / 时长 / 是否 faststart / 编码 / 关键帧位置

text:
dsh-chat-wallpaper README · 只看帧率（读 stts 表，判定是恒定帧率还是可变帧率）：node test/probe-fps.mjs "你的视频.mp4"
```

> 这两个是纯 Node 的 MP4 盒解析器：分辨率取 `tkhd` / `stsd`，帧率取 `stts`，
> faststart 看 `moov` 是否在 `mdat` 之前，关键帧读 `stss`。
> **循环点如果恰好落在关键帧上，跳转才是无缝的** —— 用它们查过再决定要不要用循环模式。

text:
dsh-chat-wallpaper README · 踩过的坑（都留了回归测试）：| 坑 | 症状 | 根因 |
|---|---|---|
| **壁纸"复活"** | 淡出看到了，但动画还在后面**一直 loop**，而且不再跟在开机动画后面 | `teardown()` 没清 `current`；更根本的是主题观察者里那句 `if (!mounted) applyNow(current)` —— 层一被移除它就**把壁纸重新挂起来**。**现在观察者只许换主题 class，绝不许挂载。** |
| **开机时机的几何误判** | 一进界面就在放，片头白做 | 用"零尺寸就算已收场"判断开机浮层 —— 而浮层刚插进 DOM 时往往就是零尺寸。改成只认它自己的 class。 |
| **全屏层吞掉所有点击** | 点哪都在控制动画，界面没法操作 | 给全屏层加了 `click → 跳过`。**全屏层永远 `pointer-events: none`。** |
| **点一下就开播** | 鼠标一点视频就播，用户没法操作 | 加了"第一次用户手势补一次 `play()`"。**全屏开场必须自动播、自动收，不能把点击当开关。** |
| **对未加载的 video 设 currentTime** | 全屏层停在第一帧、不播、盖住界面，直到看门狗才收 | 对还没 `loadedmetadata` 的元素设 `currentTime` 会让它卡在 seek 状态、`play()` 永不生效。**只在 `readyState >= 1` 时设；并先预加载。** |
| **叠化晚了 780ms** | 开机动画与视频之间闪一下聊天窗口 | 只盯 `dsu-gone`，而它**开始**淡出是更早的 `dsu-handoff`（780ms）。 |
| **改代码之后只刷新** | `web boot: 1 entry did not activate`，应用起不来 | 在宿主**运行期间**改插件客户端文件 → 宿主登记表的 `rev` 过期 → 404 → 入口没激活 → DSH 拒绝启动。**改 `lib/*.js` → 重启；改配置/换图 → 刷新。** 启动失败时用对话框里的「禁用第三方插件、备份 profile patch 并重启」兜底。 |
| **测试没在测该测的东西** | 回归测试全绿，但 bug 照样发作 | 测试直接调内部函数、绕过了真实入口（`applyNow` 才是设 `current` 的地方）。**红绿对照**才查出来。 |
| **桌面版解码 H.264 失败，壁纸陪葬** | 日志一声"视频解码失败（code 3）"，视频和底图、横幅**一起消失** | 桌面版 Electron **不带 H.264 解码器**，片库的 mp4 一放

text:
dsh-chat-wallpaper README · 致谢与来源：这个插件的两个关键做法**不是我们想出来的**，而且它**依赖另一个插件的内部约定**。
在此逐条说清楚：

dsh-chat-wallpaper README · 1. [`KylinQ01/dsh-startup-animation`](https://github.com/KylinQ01/dsh-startup-animation) — MIT：**用到了：**「把外壳底色改透明，从而让背景露出来」这个核心手法。

dsh-chat-wallpaper README · dsh-chat-wallpaper：**English** · [中文](README.md)

> A **fullscreen intro video + custom chat wallpaper** plugin for
> [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai).
>
> When your boot animation finishes, a video of your choosing takes over the
> whole screen as a "second act". When it ends, it fades out and hands the
> screen back to the chat — over a wallpaper you pick yourself.
> Swapping the wallpaper means dropping an image into a folder.

dsh-chat-wallpaper README · dsh-chat-wallpaper：🎬 **Demo (Bilibili, 37s): <https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1wspE6EE8b>**

```
   boot animation (your dsh-startup-screen)
        ↓  cross-dissolve (no hard cut, and no flash)
   fullscreen intro video (covering the chat window)
        ↓  fade out

**Panels, cards and code blocks stay fully opaque the entire time** — however
busy your wallpaper is, text stays readable.

dsh-chat-wallpaper README · How it does "background, not overlay"：There are exactly two tricks:

```css
/* 1) Make the shell's own background variables transparent.
      Panels, cards and code blocks use *different* variables, which we never
      touch — so text always lands on an opaque surface. Zero readability cost. */
html body {

On top of that sits a **veil** (`linear-gradient`): a white veil for light
themes, a dark veil for dark themes.

dsh-chat-wallpaper README · How it does "background, not overlay"：> Theme detection **never guesses DSH's internal marker names**. The JS first
> scans every attribute on `html`/`body` for `dark`, then falls back to
> measuring the shell's background luminance, and finally writes the result as
> **its own class** (`dsh-cw-dark` / `dsh-cw-light`). The CSS only ever reads
> that class — so DSH can rename its internals and nothing breaks.

dsh-chat-wallpaper README · The cross-dissolve: the hardest part of this plugin：**The problem.** The boot animation ends with a fade-out. If the intro video
also fades in, then at the seam **neither layer is opaque** — and the chat
window flashes through in between.

**The fix.** Make *their* fade-out *our* cross-dissolve: at the exact moment
they begin to fade, we are already sitting underneath at full opacity.

That requires knowing precisely when they begin. We read the
`dsh-startup-screen` source; its ending happens in **two steps**:
section: The cross-dissolve: the hardest part of this plugin
The cross-dissolve: the hardest part of this plugin

text:
dsh-chat-wallpaper README · The cross-dissolve: the hardest part of this plugin：```
t=0      dsu-handoff  → starts fading out (780 ms, with a push-in and defocus) ↘
                                                        ← we are already opaque underneath
t=780    dsu-gone     → (long since fully transparent by now)
t=1400   root element removed

> ⚠️ **Watching only `dsu-gone` is 780 ms too late** — during those 780 ms the
> boot animation is already fading the chat window through, which is exactly
> the "flash" a user sees. **That was a real bug we hit.**
section: The cross-dissolve: the hardest part of this plugin

text:
dsh-chat-wallpaper README · The cross-dissolve: the hardest part of this plugin：The signal classes are configurable (`bootLeaveClasses`) — swap them if you use
a different boot animation plugin.

**The honest trade-off.** A cross-dissolve means the video is already playing
while the fade is in progress, so roughly the first 0.4–0.7 s of the intro is
partly covered by the outgoing boot animation. That is the price of *never
flashing* — we think it is worth it.
section: The cross-dissolve: the hardest part of this plugin

dsh-chat-wallpaper README · The cross-dissolve: the hardest part of this plugin：The second seam (video → your wallpaper) needs no special handling: the video
layer fades out *while* the wallpaper is revealed underneath, which is already a
cross-dissolve.

dsh-chat-wallpaper README · Swap the video / the wallpaper：**Video** — drop files here and the newest one wins (by mtime):

```
~/.dsh/boot-animation/videos/

**Wallpaper** — drop files here and the newest one is used automatically:

~/.dsh/chat-wallpaper/

**No image at all** → after the intro fades out you get the DSH default background.

dsh-chat-wallpaper README · Settings panel：**This settings page is independent of the wallpaper layer** (its own root
element, its own `<style>` tag) — so after the intro finishes and the video
layer is removed, you can still open it from Settings. Closing the settings
dialog unmounts the page DOM; reopening attaches the same DOM again without
rebuilding it.

There is also a **「🔁 Replay intro」** button: the intro only plays once per
boot, so this lets you re-record it as many times as you like without
restarting DSH.

dsh-chat-wallpaper README · Tests：| Suite | What it guards |
|---|---|
| `smoke-client` | CSS generation, theme detection (including "a transparent background is not black") |
| `smoke-mount` | **idempotent mounting** (prevents "click the window and the background flashes and restarts from 0") + loop ranges |
| `smoke-start` | **the start gate**: while the boot animation runs, **no layer may be mounted at all**; step on stage the moment `dsu-handoff` appears |
| `smoke-once` | `once` → fade → chat; the two layers stay decoupled; **the resurrection regression**; front mode never swallows clicks |
| `smoke-timecode` | `HH:MM:SS:FF` → seconds (with a cross-check) |

dsh-chat-wallpaper README · Pitfalls we hit (all covered by regression tests)：| Pitfall | Symptom | Root cause |
|---|---|---|
| **The wallpaper "resurrects"** | you see the fade-out, but the animation keeps **looping** behind the chat — and no longer lines up with the boot animation | `teardown()` never cleared `current`; more fundamentally, the theme observer contained `if (!mounted) applyNow(current)` — the moment the layer was removed it **mounted the wallpaper again**. **The observer may now only swap the theme class, never mount anything.** |
